text: Reproduced original release-fast Immix OOM with 4 allocators, cap 128M: exit 1 after 54.2 s. One-worker 40 s control completed at 8.5 MiB without a safepoint stall. Added standalone probes/gc-repro (no SDL/Sirin/custom C); 4-worker 60 s run grew to 122.3 MiB while retained payload was 4.14 MiB. Longer isolated run and conditional-yieldpoint comparison pending. Host remains shared, not an idle performance qualification.
